name: Ryclaw: Hope
source:
Ryclaw: Hope is a short kinetic novel about a young girl named Sakura who has spent most of her life in the hospital. Coming home for the first time in months, Sakura has a dream that she wants to make a reality. You play as her older brother, who has raised Sakura since the passing of their parents. Spend time with your precocious little sister and help her wish come true.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297340/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《雷克劳：希望》是一部简短的动态小说，讲述了一个名叫佐仓的年轻女孩的故事，她一生的大部分时间都在医院度过。几个月来第一次回家，小樱有了一个想要实现的梦想。你扮演她的哥哥，自从父母去世后，他就抚养小樱。花时间陪伴你早熟的妹妹，帮助她实现愿望。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297340/]Steam[/url]]
